source.citation: Francis de Castelnau, Vues et souvenirs de l'Amérique du Nord (Paris: Arthus Bertrand, 1842), plate 18: the Chicago river entrance occupies the panel visibly numbered 4. The volume's prose explanation instead calls Chicago Fig. 1. Exact period plate inspected through Library and Archives Canada microfiche surrogate, Internet Archive item cihm 43444; held reproduction is Commons File:the Chicago1838 image.
